reviewer: operational_gap_review agent, separate from keeper implementation author
scope: Metadata configuration/state identity, confirmed-block discovery, notification fairness, durable intent/submission, exact pending receipt reconciliation, reorg handling and baseline checkpointing; generic existing LP/accounting implementation unchanged.

resolved_findings.classification: Metadata notification liveness; no custody authority
resolved_findings.problem: Advancing over the entire scan before selecting a smaller or nonwrapping notification range could repeatedly revisit a changing prefix and indefinitely omit the rest.
adversarial_schedule: 100 NFTs, scan50, notification batch10, initial cursor1, continuing changes at ordinals1 and51
100 NFTs, scan50/batch50, initial cursor98, continuing change at ordinal98
resolved_findings.resolution: Changed work advances cursor after the selected range, modulo current count; unchanged scans advance over the full window. The cursor is durably saved before submission without marking notification success.

resolved_findings.classification: Metadata cache fingerprint correctness; no custody authority
resolved_findings.problem: Checkpointing the old triggering observation after a notification executed in a different stage could suppress a later return to the trigger stage (A→B→A). An aged/reorged trigger could also leave an old prior fingerprint suppressing a retry.
resolved_findings.resolution: Re-read exact selected ordinal/token identities, traits/evolution/availability and fixed deployment bindings at the confirmed receipt block; re-anchor that block after the reads and checkpoint its state. Retain original durable trigger payload. For invalid/aged triggers, clear prior selected fingerprints only after a canonical receipt check. Malformed execution state or receipt reorg retains pending without changing cost/cache success.

resolved_findings.origin: Implementation author found before freeze2; separately rechecked here
resolved_findings.problem: An invalid triggering observation previously returned before a final receipt-anchor check, potentially clearing pending during a simultaneous receipt reorg.
resolved_findings.resolution: Final receipt block anchoring precedes both normal checkpointing and invalid-trigger cache invalidation.

reviewed_properties: Explicit optional NFT target and persistent identity bind chain/controller/NFT; a changed deployment cannot silently reuse or erase pending state.
Confirmed observation reads verify sealed access, NFT/Vault module bindings, canonical chain, cap1000 and batch50. Live operation checks reviewed runtime identities.
Ordinal/token forward and reverse mapping, canonical ABI booleans/stages, record uniqueness and bounded50-record payload are validated before constructing fixed zero-value notification calldata.
Dry run, failed simulation/budget checks, ambiguous submission, reverts and unconfirmed receipts never mark notification fingerprints successful.
Existing nonce/from/to/calldata/value/hash checks, private signer inputs, sanitized signing environment, cost limits and durable pre-broadcast intent apply to metadata transactions.
Receipt and observation anchors are rechecked; invalidated successful-notification records are reconsidered after later reorgs.
Metadata and LP maintenance alternate priority. The NFT scan is separate from shared-pool upkeep and does not create per-NFT LP rebalance calls.
Notification remains usable through strategy pause and unavailable valuation; no LP, claim, royalty or migration authority is added.
remaining_limits: The fingerprint tracks evolution stage, valuation availability and reveal readiness, not every intra-stage USD-value fluctuation; marketplace numeric metadata may therefore be cached between refreshes.
An ERC4906 event is a notification, not a guarantee of when an external marketplace fetches or displays artwork.
The targeted executions use mock RPC and mock encrypted-keystore signer results; no real live signer, production request or transaction was executed.
Configured confirmations and two-anchor checks do not guarantee absolute chain finality or defend against a dishonest RPC; actual chain/provider policies and staged recovery remain required.
Metadata refresh defaults disabled and production authorities/configuration remain unselected; no deployment/funded operation is approved.
Real VRF, immutable complete artwork publication, selected native-ETH/Pons custody/routing, actual bridge backing, staged monitoring and independent audit remain separate production gates.
